model_answer: 131M (US households) × 0.65 (share of households living in houses) × 0.1 (share of house households that hire window cleaners) × 2 (cleanings per hiring household per year) × 250 (average price per cleaning) ≈ $4.26B
explanation: 131M (US households) × 0.65 (share of households living in houses) × 0.1 (share of house households that hire window cleaners) × 2 (cleanings per hiring household per year) × 250 (average price per cleaning) ≈ $4.26B.
